name: Drums3D
summary:
Drums3D puts a full drum kit in front of you. Strike the drums and cymbals with the sticks in your controllers: the harder you hit, the louder it sounds.

PLAY ALONG
• Grooves in the style of 150 famous songs: rock, pop, funk, metal, Latin and more
• Let the groove keep the kick while your hands play, or play everything yourself
• Slow the tempo down to learn, speed it up to push yourself

PRACTICE THAT MEASURES YOU
• Rings show each hit just before it lands
• Your turn: the groove goes silent, a click stay
